newsitem.title: USA: Hertz IPO prices at $24 per share.
newsitem.headline: Hertz IPO prices at $24 per share.

text.p: Rental car giant Hertz Corp.'s 20 million share initial public offering was priced at the top of its range at $24 per share, lead underwriter JP Morgan said Thursday.
Of the total 20.01 million shares, 18.27 million are slated for the United States and Canada, the underwriter said.
The company had originally filed for a 17.4 million global share offering with an overallotment option of an additional 2.61 million shares. The price range was $21 to $24 a share.
The Ford Motor Co. unit's deal has been widely heralded as a winner in an otherwise moribund market for initial public offerings.
"This is a stock that is a no-brainer," said David Menlow, president of Springfield, N.J.-based IPO Financial Network Corp. "It has been solidly on our hot list for the last six weeks."

Both Menlow and John Fitzgibbon, editor of the IPO Aftermarket, said there were indications that the stock was likely to rise $2 or $3 in its debut on the New York Stock Exchange on Friday. Both said they would not be surprised if the stock did considerably better than that.
"It's going to be a big, booming opening," said Fitzgibbon. Investors who have been shunning IPOs this year "now have something to bet on," he said.

After the offering, Ford will own more than 50 percent of Hertz's class A shares, and all of the Class B shares. According to the filing, the class B common stock has five votes per share, whereas the class A common stock offers one vote a share.
Hertz is ranked as the world's largest rental car company in terms of revenues and fleet size.
Ford has had an investment in Hertz since 1987, when it sought a captive customer for its excess vehicles. Three years ago, Ford took over all of Hertz.
Now, the U.S. No. 2 automaker is divesting some of the company as part of a campaign to unlock value in Ford's non-automotive assets.

Earlier this month, Hertz, benefiting from higher U.S. car rental revenues, posted record first quarter earnings of $19.7 million, compared to $8.8 million a year ago. Revenues were a record $878.4 million, compared to $803.1 million. HRZ.N
